metadata.title: Robinhood Sees More Flows Into Bitcoin ETFs

content.text: Robinhood Sees More Flows Into Bitcoin ETFs Bloomberg Tue, August 11, 2026 at 11:27 AM PDT HOOD BTC-USD Robinhood Senior Vice President and General Manager of Crypto Johann Kerbrat talks about investor sentiment around crypto, a hack of Coldcard wallets and how the business is expanding in the United Kingdom.
